Master Ball.desc: The best Ball with the ultimate performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

Ultra Ball.desc: A very high-grade Ball that offers a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.

Great Ball.desc: A good, quality Ball that offers a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.

Poké Ball.desc: A Ball thrown to catch a wild Pokémon. It is designed in a capsule style.

Safari Ball.desc: A special Ball that is used only in the Safari Zone. It is finished in a camouflage pattern.

Net Ball.desc: A somewhat different Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.

Dive Ball.desc: A somewhat different Ball that works especially well on Pokémon deep in the sea.

Nest Ball.desc: A somewhat different Ball that works especially well on weaker Pokémon.

Repeat Ball.desc: A somewhat different Ball that works especially well on Pokémon caught before.

Timer Ball.desc: A somewhat different Ball that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.

Luxury Ball.desc: A comfortable Ball that makes a captured wild Pokémon quickly grow friendly.

Premier Ball.desc: A rare Ball that has been specially made to commemorate an event of some sort.

Potion.desc: A spray-type wound medicine. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.

Antidote.desc: A spray-type medicine. It heals one Pokémon from a poisoning.

Burn Heal.desc: A spray-type medicine. It heals one Pokémon of a burn.

Ice Heal.desc: A spray-type medicine. It defrosts a frozen Pokémon.

Awakening.desc: A spray-type medicine. It awakens a sleeping Pokémon.

Parlyz Heal.desc: A spray-type medicine. It heals one Pokémon from paralysis.

Full Restore.desc: A medicine that fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of one Pokémon.

Max Potion.desc: A spray-type wound medicine. It fully restores the HP of one Pokémon.

Hyper Potion.desc: A spray-type wound medicine. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.

Super Potion.desc: A spray-type wound medicine. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

Full Heal.desc: A spray-type medicine. It heals all the status problems of one Pokémon.

Revive.desc: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon, restoring HP by half the maximum amount.

Max Revive.desc: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon, restoring HP fully.

Fresh Water.desc: Water with a high mineral content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

Soda Pop.desc: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.

Lemonade.desc: A very sweet drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 80 points.

Moomoo Milk.desc: Highly nutritious milk. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 100 points.

Energypowder.desc: A very bitter medicine powder. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

Energy Root.desc: A very bitter root. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.

Heal Powder.desc: A very bitter medicine powder. It heals all the status problems of one Pokémon.

Revival Herb.desc: A very bitter medicinal herb. It revives a fainted Pokémon, restoring HP fully.

Ether.desc: Restores a selected move's PP by 10 points for one Pokémon.

Max Ether.desc: Fully restores a selected move's PP for one Pokémon.

Elixir.desc: Restores the PP of all moves for one Pokémon by 10 points each.

Max Elixir.desc: Fully restores the PP of all moves for one Pokémon.

Lava Cookie.desc: Lavaridge Town's local specialty. It heals all the status problems of one Pokémon.

Blue Flute.desc: A blue glass flute that awakens a sleeping Pokémon.

Yellow Flute.desc: A yellow glass flute that snaps one Pokémon out of confusion.

Red Flute.desc: A red glass flute that snaps one Pokémon out of infatuation.

Black Flute.desc: A black glass flute. When blown, it makes wild Pokémon less likely to appear.

White Flute.desc: A white glass flute. When blown, it makes wild Pokémon more likely to appear.

Berry Juice.desc: A 100% pure juice. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.

Sacred Ash.desc: Revives all fainted Pokémon, restoring HP fully.

Shoal Salt.desc: Pure salt obtained from deep inside the Shoal Cave. It is extremely salty.

Shoal Shell.desc: A pretty seashell found deep inside the Shoal Cave. It is striped in blue and white.

Red Shard.desc: A small red shard. It appears to be from some sort of a tool made long ago.

Blue Shard.desc: A small blue shard. It appears to be from some sort of a tool made long ago.

Yellow Shard.desc: A small yellow shard. It appears to be from some sort of a tool made long ago.

Green Shard.desc: A small green shard. It appears to be from some sort of a tool made long ago.

HP Up.desc: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base HP of one Pokémon.

Protein.desc: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Attack stat of one Pokémon.

Iron.desc: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Defense stat of one Pokémon.

Carbos.desc: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Speed stat of one Pokémon.

Calcium.desc: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Sp. Atk stat of one Pokémon.

Rare Candy.desc: A candy that is packed with energy. It raises the level of a Pokémon by one.

PP Up.desc: Slightly raises the maximum PP of a selected move for one Pokémon.

Zinc.desc: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Sp. Def stat of one Pokémon.

PP Max.desc: Raises the PP of a selected move to its maximum level for one Pokémon.

Guard Spec..desc: An item that prevents stat reduction among party Pokémon for five turns after use.

Dire Hit.desc: Raises the critical-hit ratio of Pokémon in battle. Wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

X Attack.desc: Raises the Attack stat of Pokémon in battle. Wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

X Defend.desc: Raises the Defense stat of Pokémon in battle. Wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

X Speed.desc: Raises the Speed stat of Pokémon in battle. Wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

X Accuracy.desc: Raises the accuracy stat of Pokémon in battle. Wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

X Special.desc: Raises the Sp. Atk stat of Pokémon in battle. Wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

Poké Doll.desc: An attractive doll. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.

Fluffy Tail.desc: An attractive item. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.

Super Repel.desc: Prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 200 steps.

Max Repel.desc: Prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 250 steps.

Escape Rope.desc: A long, durable rope. Use it to escape instantly from a cave or a dungeon.

Repel.desc: Prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 100 steps.

Sun Stone.desc: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as red as the sun.

Moon Stone.desc: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as black as the night sky.

Fire Stone.desc: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is colored orange.

Thunderstone.desc: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a thunderbolt pattern.

Water Stone.desc: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a clear light blue.

Leaf Stone.desc: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a leaf pattern.

Tinymushroom.desc: A small and rare mushroom. It is quite popular among certain people.

Big Mushroom.desc: A large and rare mushroom. It is very popular among certain people.

Pearl.desc: A relatively small pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold cheaply.

Big Pearl.desc: A quite-large pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold at a high price.

Stardust.desc: A pretty red sand with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a high price.

Star Piece.desc: A shard of a pretty gem that sparkles in a red color. It can be sold at a high price.

Nugget.desc: A nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price.

Heart Scale.desc: A pretty, heart-shaped scale that is extremely rare. It glows faintly in the colors of a rainbow.

Orange Mail.desc: A piece of Mail featuring a cute Zigzagoon print. It is to be held by a Pokémon.

Harbor Mail.desc: A piece of Mail featuring a cute Wingull print. It is to be held by a Pokémon.

Glitter Mail.desc: A piece of Mail featuring a cute Pikachu print. It is to be held by a Pokémon.

Mech Mail.desc: A piece of Mail featuring a cute Magnemite print. It is to be held by a Pokémon.

Wood Mail.desc: A piece of Mail featuring a cute Slakoth print. It is to be held by a Pokémon.

Wave Mail.desc: A piece of Mail featuring a cute Wailmer print. It is to be held by a Pokémon.

Bead Mail.desc: A piece of Mail to be held by a Pokémon. It will bear the print of the Pokémon holding it.

Shadow Mail.desc: A piece of Mail featuring a cute Duskull print. It is to be held by a Pokémon.

Tropic Mail.desc: A piece of Mail featuring a cute Bellossom print. It is to be held by a Pokémon.

Dream Mail.desc: A piece of Mail to be held by a Pokémon. It will bear the print of the Pokémon holding it.

Fab Mail.desc: A piece of Mail featuring a gorgeous, extravagant print. It is to be held by a Pokémon.

Retro Mail.desc: A piece of Mail featuring a print of three cute Pokémon. It is to be held by a Pokémon.

Cheri Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to heal paralysis.
Cheri Berry.held: Held in battle: cures paralysis straight away.

Chesto Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to wake up.
Chesto Berry.held: Held in battle: cures sleep straight away.

Pecha Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to cure poison.
Pecha Berry.held: Held in battle: cures poison straight away.

Rawst Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to heal a burn.
Rawst Berry.held: Held in battle: cures a burn straight away.

Aspear Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle for defrosting.
Aspear Berry.held: Held in battle: cures freezing straight away.

Leppa Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to restore 10 PP.
Leppa Berry.held: Held in battle: restores 10 PP to a move that runs out.

Oran Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to restore 10 HP.
Oran Berry.held: Held in battle: restores 10 HP once its HP falls below half.

Persim Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to lift confusion.
Persim Berry.held: Held in battle: cures confusion straight away.

Lum Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to heal any problem.
Lum Berry.held: Held in battle: cures any status problem or confusion straight away.

Sitrus Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to restore 30 HP.
Sitrus Berry.held: Held in battle: restores 30 HP once its HP falls below half.

Figy Berry.desc: A hold item that restores HP but may cause confusion when used.
Figy Berry.held: Held in battle: restores 1/8 of max HP when HP is low, but confuses a Pokémon that dislikes the flavor.

Wiki Berry.desc: A hold item that restores HP but may cause confusion when used.
Wiki Berry.held: Held in battle: restores 1/8 of max HP when HP is low, but confuses a Pokémon that dislikes the flavor.

Mago Berry.desc: A hold item that restores HP but may cause confusion when used.
Mago Berry.held: Held in battle: restores 1/8 of max HP when HP is low, but confuses a Pokémon that dislikes the flavor.

Aguav Berry.desc: A hold item that restores HP but may cause confusion when used.
Aguav Berry.held: Held in battle: restores 1/8 of max HP when HP is low, but confuses a Pokémon that dislikes the flavor.

Iapapa Berry.desc: A hold item that restores HP but may cause confusion when used.
Iapapa Berry.held: Held in battle: restores 1/8 of max HP when HP is low, but confuses a Pokémon that dislikes the flavor.

Razz Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Bluk Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Nanab Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Wepear Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Pinap Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Pomeg Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Kelpsy Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Qualot Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Hondew Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Grepa Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Tamato Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Cornn Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Magost Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Rabuta Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Nomel Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Spelon Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Pamtre Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Watmel Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Durin Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Belue Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Liechi Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it raises the Attack stat in a pinch.
Liechi Berry.held: Held in battle: raises Attack when HP is low.

Ganlon Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it raises the Defense stat in a pinch.
Ganlon Berry.held: Held in battle: raises Defense when HP is low.

Salac Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it raises the Speed stat in a pinch.
Salac Berry.held: Held in battle: raises Speed when HP is low.

Petaya Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it raises the Sp. Atk stat in a pinch.
Petaya Berry.held: Held in battle: raises Sp. Atk when HP is low.

Apicot Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it raises the Sp. Def stat in a pinch.
Apicot Berry.held: Held in battle: raises Sp. Def when HP is low.

Lansat Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it raises the critical-hit ratio in a pinch.
Lansat Berry.held: Held in battle: raises the critical-hit ratio when HP is low.

Starf Berry.desc: When held by a Pokémon, it sharply raises one stat in a pinch.
Starf Berry.held: Held in battle: sharply raises a random stat when HP is low.

Enigma Berry.desc: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

Brightpowder.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It casts a tricky glare that lowers the opponent's accuracy.

White Herb.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It restores any lowered stat in battle. It can be used only once.

Macho Brace.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It promotes strong growth but lowers Speed while it is held.

Exp. Share.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder gets a share of EXP. points without having to battle.

Quick Claw.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A light and sharp claw. The holder may be able to strike first.

Soothe Bell.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A bell with a comforting chime that makes the holder calm and friendly.

Mental Herb.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It snaps the holder out of infatuation. It can be used once.

Choice Band.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It powers up one move, which becomes the only usable one.

King's Rock.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the foe to flinch upon taking damage.

Silverpowder.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A shiny silver powder that boosts the power of Bug-type moves.

Amulet Coin.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles the battle money if the holding Pokémon takes part.

Cleanse Tag.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It repels wild Pokémon if the holder is first in the party.

Soul Dew.desc: An orb to be held by a Latios or Latias. It raises the Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

Deepseatooth.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A fang that gleams a sharp silver. It raises the Sp. Atk stat.

Deepseascale.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A scale that shines a faint pink. It raises the Sp. Def stat.

Smoke Ball.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holding Pokémon can flee from any wild Pokémon for sure.

Everstone.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holding Pokémon is prevented from evolving.

Focus Band.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holding Pokémon may endure an attack, leaving just 1 HP.

Lucky Egg.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. An egg filled with happiness that earns extra EXP. points in battle.

Scope Lens.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A lens that boosts the critical-hit ratio of the holding Pokémon.

Metal Coat.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A special metallic film that boosts the power of Steel-type moves.

Leftovers.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holding Pokémon gradually regains HP during battle.

Dragon Scale.desc: A thick and tough scale. A Dragon-type Pokémon may be holding it.

Light Ball.desc: An orb to be held by a Pikachu that raises the Sp. Atk stat. Touching it may cause a shock.

Soft Sand.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A loose, silky sand that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

Hard Stone.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. An unbreakable stone that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

Miracle Seed.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A seed imbued with life that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

Blackglasses.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A shady-looking pair of glasses that boosts Dark-type moves.

Black Belt.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A belt that boosts determination and Fighting-type moves.

Magnet.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A powerful magnet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

Mystic Water.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A teardrop-shaped gem that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

Sharp Beak.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A long, sharp beak that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.

Poison Barb.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A small, poisonous barb that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.

Nevermeltice.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A piece of ice that repels heat and boosts Ice-type moves.

Spell Tag.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A sinister, eerie tag that boosts Ghost-type moves.

Twistedspoon.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A spoon imbued with telekinetic power boosts Psychic-type moves.

Charcoal.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A combustible fuel that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.

Dragon Fang.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A hard and sharp fang that boosts the power of Dragon-type moves.

Silk Scarf.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of Normal-type moves.

Up-grade.desc: A transparent device filled with all sorts of data. It is made by Silph Co.

Shell Bell.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holding Pokémon regains some HP upon striking the foe.

Sea Incense.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It slightly boosts the power of Water-type moves.

Lax Incense.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Its tricky aroma slightly reduces the foe's accuracy.

Lucky Punch.desc: A glove to be held by a Chansey. It raises Chansey's critical-hit ratio.

Metal Powder.desc: A fine, hard powder to be held by a Ditto. It raises Ditto's Defense stat.

Thick Club.desc: A hard bone of some sort to be held by a Cubone or Marowak. It raises the Attack stat.

Stick.desc: A stick of leek to be held by a Farfetch'd. It raises Farfetch'd's critical-hit ratio.

Red Scarf.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the holding Pokémon's Cool condition in Contests.

Blue Scarf.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the holding Pokémon's Beauty condition in Contests.

Pink Scarf.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the holding Pokémon's Cute condition in Contests.

Green Scarf.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the holding Pokémon's Smart condition in Contests.

Yellow Scarf.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the holding Pokémon's Tough condition in Contests.

Mach Bike.desc: A folding bicycle that is at least twice as fast as walking.

Coin Case.desc: A case for holding Coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 9,999 Coins.

Itemfinder.desc: A device used for finding items. If there is a hidden item nearby when it is used, it emits a signal.

Old Rod.desc: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to  fish for wild Pokémon.

Good Rod.desc: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to  fish for wild Pokémon.

Super Rod.desc: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild Pokémon.

S.S. Ticket.desc: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.s. Anne. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

Contest Pass.desc: The pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.

Wailmer Pail.desc: A nifty watering pail. Use it to promote strong growth in Berries planted in soft soil.

Devon Goods.desc: A package that contains mechanical parts of some sort made by the Devon Corporation.

Soot Sack.desc: A sack used to collect volcanic ash automatically during walks over deep ash.

Basement Key.desc: The key to New Mauville, which was constructed beneath Mauville City.

Acro Bike.desc: A folding bicycle that is capable of stunts like jumps and wheelies.

{pokeblock} Case.desc: A case for holding {Pokeblock}S made with a Berry Blender. It releases one {Pokeblock} when shaken.

Letter.desc: An extremely important letter to Steven from the President of the Devon Corporation.

Eon Ticket.desc: The ticket required for sailing on a ferry to a distant southern island. It features a drawing of an island.

Red Orb.desc: An orb that glows red. It is said to contain an incredible power from ancient times.

Blue Orb.desc: An orb that glows blue. It is said to contain an incredible power from ancient times.

Scanner.desc: A device used to search for life-forms in water. It looks too difficult to use.

Go-goggles.desc: A pair of protective goggles. They enable a Trainer to travel through even desert sandstorms.

Meteorite.desc: A meteorite that fell from space onto Mt. Moon long ago. It is very lumpy and hard.

Rm. 1 Key.desc: A key that opens the door to Room 1 inside the Abandoned Ship. It is old and looks easily broken.

Rm. 2 Key.desc: A key that opens the door to Room 2 inside the Abandoned Ship. It is old and looks easily broken.

Rm. 4 Key.desc: A key that opens the door to Room 4 inside the Abandoned Ship. It is old and looks easily broken.

Rm. 6 Key.desc: A key that opens the door to Room 6 inside the Abandoned Ship. It is old and looks easily broken.

Storage Key.desc: A key that opens the storage hold inside the Abandoned Ship. It is old and looks easily broken.

Root Fossil.desc: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be part of a plant root.

Claw Fossil.desc: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be part of a claw.

Devon Scope.desc: A scope that signals the presence of any unseeable Pokémon. It is made by the Devon Corp.

Oak's Parcel.desc: A parcel to be delivered to Prof. Oak from Viridian City's Pokémon Mart.

Poké Flute.desc: A flute that is said to instantly awaken any Pokémon. It has a lovely tone.

Secret Key.desc: The key to Cinnabar Island Gym's front door. It is colored red and decorated.

Bike Voucher.desc: Take this voucher to the Bike Shop in Cerulean City and exchange it for a bicycle.

Gold Teeth.desc: A set of false teeth lost by the Safari Zone's Warden. It makes his smile sparkle.

Old Amber.desc: A piece of amber that contains the genes of an ancient Pokémon. It is clear with a reddish tint.

Card Key.desc: A card-type key that unlocks doors in Silph Co.'s Head Office in Saffron City.

Lift Key.desc: A key that operates the elevator in Team Rocket's Hideout. It bears the Team Rocket logo.

Helix Fossil.desc: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be part of a seashell.

Dome Fossil.desc: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be part of a shell.

Silph Scope.desc: A scope that makes unseeable Pokémon visible. It is made by Silph Co.

Bicycle.desc: A folding bicycle that allows faster movement than the Running Shoes.

Town Map.desc: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your  present location.

Vs Seeker.desc: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. The battery charges while traveling.

Fame Checker.desc: A device that enables you to recall what you've heard and seen about famous people.

TM Case.desc: A case that holds TMs and HMs. It is attached to the Bag's compartment for important items.

Berry Pouch.desc: A pouch for carrying Berries. It is attached to the Bag's compartment for important items.

Teachy TV.desc: A television set that is tuned to a program with useful tips for novice Trainers.

Tri-pass.desc: A pass for ferries between One, Two, and Three Island. It has a drawing of three islands.

Rainbow Pass.desc: A pass for ferries between Vermilion and the Sevii Islands. It features a drawing of a rainbow.

Tea.desc: An aromatic tea prepared by an old lady. It will slake even the worst thirst.

Mysticticket.desc: A ticket required to board the ship to Navel Rock. It glows with a mystic light.

Auroraticket.desc: A ticket required to board the ship to Birth Island. It glows beautifully.

Powder Jar.desc: A jar for storing Berry Powder made using a Berry Crusher.

Ruby.desc: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a red glow. It symbolizes passion.

Sapphire.desc: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a blue glow. It symbolizes honesty.
